title: How to Build a Subscription App With Recurring Payments (No Coding Required)
summary: How to build a subscription app with Stripe recurring payments, user auth, and plan gating — without code. Database, auth, and hosting included with Blink.
body_markdown: No — build the app first, then connect Stripe. Blink generates the full subscription structure (database schema, Stripe Checkout flow, webhook handler) without needing your Stripe account upfront. You connect Stripe in step 2, after the app exists, by pasting your live publishable and secret keys from your Stripe dashboard when Blink asks — only live keys are accepted, not test ones. This means you can see the full UI before payments go live.
